movelist.name: High Horsepower
movelist.effect: High Horsepower may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, High Horsepower gains Smite.

movelist.name: Play Rough
movelist.effect: Play Rough lowers the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage on 17-20 during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Bulldoze
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is lowered 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.effect: While suffering from Burn, Poison, Paralysis, Freezing, or while Asleep, the user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. If suffering from none of these conditions, the user loses any Combat Stages gained this way.

abilities.name: Frighten
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Arena Trap
abilities.effect: Once Arena Trap is activated, all foes within 5 meters of the user are considered Slowed and Trapped. This does not affect targets of the Flying Type, or with a Levitate, Sky, or Burrow Speed of 4 or higher. The user may end the effect as a Free Action, and the effect ends if the user is Fainted or returned to a Poké Ball.
